ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio; approximately 90% of pixels in the visible fluke region fall within the low-intensity [0-50] range, with sparse high-intensity [200-255] clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation layer across both lobes. Distinctive high-contrast white annular (ring-shaped) clusters are mapped predominantly in the distal regions of both lobes, with a higher spatial density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary; several distinct peaks and valleys visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge is partially obscured by water splash but shows a similarly jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile extending from the median notch toward the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast, circular white annular patterns (approximate 5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, representing localized pigment loss in ring shapes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of circular/ring-shaped scarring across the fluke surface, likely corresponding to past barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive and geometrically uniform ring-shaped scarring pattern across both lobes.
